title: Horrible.
text: Horrible.. This bookcase looks nice and the finish paint looks good but it's very cheaply made the back is cardboard very thin and the seam from it being folded in the packaging doesn't go away, the little plastic things holding the shelves in place are very flimsy so you can't put a heavy book in there or anything heavier than an ashtray, also mine is leaning and doesn't seem to be stable... Don't waste your money on this.

product_metadata.title: South Shore Axess 5-Shelf Bookcase - Pure White
features: VERSATILE STORAGE: Instantly organize and display books, papers, toys or decorative items in 5 open and easily accessible adjustable storage spaces.
MODERN SIMPLICITY: With sleek contemporary styling, the bookcase features clean lines which will make it an elegant addition to any existing living room, office or bedroom decor.
GENEROUS CAPACITY: The practical bookcase features a combination of 3 adjustable shelves supporting 25 lbs each, and a single fixed shelf supporting up to 35 lbs in weight.
PRODUCT DIMENSIONS: 28" W x 11.5" D x 68.75" H | 66 Pounds
ECO-FRIENDLY: Made in North America with non-toxic laminated particleboard, this piece of furniture meets or exceeds all North American safety standards.
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Requires complete assembly by 2 adults (tools not included)
5-YEAR LIMITED MANUFACTURER WARRANTY: Shop with confidence knowing that we proudly stand behind this piece of furniture with a full 5-year limited manufacturer warranty.
description: Ideal for your binders, books or decorative items, this versatile 5-shelf bookcase can meet all your storage needs. Both practical and attractive with its sleek modern styling, this bookcase is sure to enhance the look of any room in your home, and the neutral, contemporary design of this furniture piece ensures it will complement any existing decor.

The bookcase features 5 open, practical and accessible storage spaces, separated by 1 fixed shelf that can support up to 35 lb and 3 adjustable shelves that can support up to 25 lb. An effective and reliable storage solution for kids and adults bedrooms, living rooms, offices and playrooms.
Shop with confidence knowing that we proudly stand behind our products with a full 5-year limited manufacturer warranty.
Assembly is required. Please note tools and accessories are not included.

Our products meet or exceed all North American safety standards. Ships in a heavy box, make sure to have a friend with you. Packaging tested and certified to reduce the risk of damage during shipment. We recommend 2 people to assemble. Made in North America with non-toxic laminated particleboard.
